name: suki
description: SUKI — offline-first ledger and stock app for a sari-sari store. Vite web, NestJS sync API, shared domain package.
//overrides: vite-plugin-pwa's peer range spans Vite 3-8, so npm satisfied it by installing a second Vite (7.x) at the root while the web app kept its pinned 6.3.4 nested. Two Vite copies means two sets of Plugin types, and `tsc -b` fails on a plugin array that is structurally identical but nominally from the wrong node_modules. One copy, pinned to the version the app is actually built with.
